SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id AND payment_status="ok")) paid, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id)) shipped, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL)) deliv, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id)) refd FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status
SELECT substr(order_ts,1,4), COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n, COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) paid FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status="ok" GROUP BY o.status
SELECT o.status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) shipped, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
SELECT o.status, COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status

SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0 gross, COUNT(*) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.category="backpack" AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>="2025-01-01" AND o.order_ts<"2026-01-01"

SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd), COUNT(*), SUM(r.refund_ts>="2026"), SUM(r.refund_ts<"2025") FROM refunds r JOIN order_items i ON i.item_id=r.item_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.category="backpack" AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>="2025-01-01" AND o.order_ts<"2026-01-01"

SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r JOIN order_items i ON i.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.category="backpack" AND r.refund_ts>="2025-01-01" AND r.refund_ts<"2026-01-01"
